notes.title: 「Millennium Dream」"Demo Coming Soon!
notes.content:
Hello Dreamers!

On this brief escape from reality, "Millennium Dream" will take you deep into your memories, exploring those old spaces shrouded in nostalgic warmth and eerie unease.

This demo version includes the following carefully crafted experience areas:

The Way Home: A familiar yet lonely home, waiting for you to recover lost memories.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45462186/3a0468116ca7b2f1f051f8b75e50ca6129a5334e.png

Deserted Pedestrian Street: In the silent underground mall, only indifferent mannequins accompany your journey.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45462186/9d4ad88b90507b2b59b7ca1a21b6011d3846b0d8.png

Error Space-H: An abnormal space that defies common sense—what secrets are hidden beneath the pool?
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45462186/ffcde2d803d998a85c4f303c747a776a87431f2b.png

Hidden Level: Every evening, the courtyard tree will guide you to the unknown…
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45462186/4cc13250d1149ac290ea964259e39d25af57a807.png

Based on previous tests, we have made significant optimizations:



 Fixed numerous crash bugs, greatly improving overall game stability.



 Added dynamic weather and time systems.



 Added a camera shake toggle to reduce 3D motion sickness.



 Introduced more interactive content and explorable areas.

Thank you for your attention and support for "Millennium Dream"! The demo will be launched soon—stay tuned and get ready to step into that familiar yet strange dream world!

notes.title: [Indie Game In Development] "Millennium Dream" First Playtest Launch!
notes.content:
What’s the Main Goal of This Playtest? (Pay Attention!)

Core Objective: Performance Stress Test!
We really need to see how the game runs on different PC setups. Whether you have a high-end rig or a budget machine, your feedback is super important for helping us optimize the game! (๑•̀ㅂ•́)و✧ Please tell us about your frame rates and whether the game runs smoothly for you!

Secondary Goal:
While you’re at it, let us know how our UI design and basic controls feel—are they stable and easy to use?

❗❗❗ Very Important Notes (Please Read!) ❗❗❗

Content is Extremely Early!
This test version only contains a small number of unfinished test levels. The art and visuals are all at an early stage, and definitely do NOT represent the final quality of the game! Please understand that the main purpose here is to help us check the game’s performance foundation~

Gameplay Not Implemented Yet!
This build basically does NOT include the core gameplay (features like collecting, full photo simulation, or mini-games are not present yet), so it does NOT represent the final gameplay or content! Please don’t judge the game’s fun factor based on this version~

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45462186/5ee2c395648d08545a67d9272cd2b8efe5913a17.png

What Kind of Game is “Millennium Dream”?

Genre: Walking simulator focused on atmospheric exploration

Style: Realistic, VHS visual effects, nostalgic vibes

Planned core mechanics: Exploration and discovery, collecting old objects, photo simulation, mini-games with nostalgic flair

Story background: Set in China, around 1995-2005

📸 Special Event: Capture Your #MillenniumDreamMoment!

Even though the gameplay isn’t complete, we’ve included a basic photo mode! If you see any scenes that catch your eye while testing, feel free to snap a picture!

Share your creations: Post the photos or screenshots you take in “Millennium Dream” to Bilibili or any other platform you like—just remember to use the hashtag #千禧梦瞬间# (#MillenniumDreamMoment)!

We can’t wait to see your unique perspectives: Show us the atmospheric, story-rich corners you discover!

notes.title: February's development update
notes.content:
February's development work has been progressing smoothly, and I'm excited to share the latest game updates with you

This month, I mainly focused on optimizing character controls, enhancing visual effects, and enriching the gameplay experience. Here are the specific updates:  

🚀 1. Character Control Enhancements
> Improved character movement fluidity and responsiveness, making controls feel more natural and smooth.  
> Refined camera shake details to make character actions more dynamic and immersive.  

🧗‍♂️ 2. New Ladder Climbing Mechanic
> Characters can now climb ladders, adding new gameplay and exploration possibilities.  
> The ladder climbing controls are simple and intuitive, further enriching scene interactions.  

📼 3. VHS Effect Optimization
> Adjusted the VHS visual filter for a more realistic look.  
> Optimized visual noise in the VHS effect to enhance player immersion and overall visual experience.  

🌃 4. Underground Pedestrian Street Level Update
> Added an underground pedestrian street scene—do you remember the feeling of walking hand in hand with your parents back then?  
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45462186/097d10756644297874269c803d1f9bcbf86adc0f.png

🏠 5. Millennium Wooden Interior Level Update
> Introduced a nostalgic millennium-style wooden interior level, bringing you back to the warmth of your childhood home and letting you relive old memories.  
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45462186/d83c413e5d74d94e0ac1cfea8ddf4d5307a0fb8b.png

A huge thank you to all shareholders for your support and feedback! Don't forget to add the game to your wishlist! 🚀
